belgian_pro_league.name: Belgian Pro League
belgian_pro_league.text: Recent Belgian Pro League results saw Anderlecht beat KVC Westerlo 4-1, while Royal Charleroi SC's 5-2 win over RAAL La Louvière was the biggest margin. Standard Liege drew 1-1 with KV Kortrijk.

bundesliga.name: Bundesliga
bundesliga.text: SV 07 Elversberg's 4-1 win over 1. FSV Mainz 05 was the biggest margin of the recent Bundesliga results. Borussia Mönchengladbach and SC Paderborn 07 drew 0-0, while FC Bayern München and Borussia Dortmund drew 2-2 and 1. FC Union Berlin and 1. FC Köln drew 1-1.

champions_league.name: Champions League
champions_league.text: The biggest margin across the recent Champions League results was Como 1907's 9-1 win at Racing Club de Lens, followed by Paris Saint-Germain's 6-0 victory at Villarreal. The only draw was Bodo/Glimt 0-0 Lille OSC.

eredivisie.name: Eredivisie
eredivisie.text: FC Twente's 9-0 win at Excelsior was the biggest margin of the recent Eredivisie round, while PSV Eindhoven also recorded a 7-0 victory over Willem II. Feyenoord Rotterdam drew 1-1 with Fortuna Sittard, the only draw among the listed results.

europa_league.name: Europa League
europa_league.text: Stade Rennais FC 1901 and Olympiacos played out a 0-0 draw. That was the only result, so the biggest margin was a draw.

la_liga.name: La Liga
la_liga.text: FC Barcelona's 6-1 win over Deportivo Alavés was the biggest margin of the recent La Liga results. Rayo Vallecano beat Celta Vigo 3-0 and Real Madrid won 3-0 at Racing Santander, while no matches ended in a draw.

ligue_1.name: Ligue 1
ligue_1.text: Paris Saint-Germain's 5-1 win at Le Havre AC and RC Strasbourg Alsace's 5-1 win over AJ Auxerre shared the biggest margin of the recent Ligue 1 results. OGC Nice also beat Stade Rennais FC 5-2, while there were no draws in the listed matches.

premier_league.name: Premier League
premier_league.text: Chelsea, Bournemouth, Brentford and Tottenham all won 2-0, while Coventry City's 3-1 win over Sunderland was the biggest margin of the recent results. Hull City drew 2-2 with Ipswich Town and Aston Villa drew 1-1 with Fulham.

primeira_liga.name: Primeira Liga
primeira_liga.text: FC Porto recorded the biggest margin of the recent Primeira Liga results with a 4-0 win over Estoril, while Braga also claimed a 3-0 victory against FC Famalicao. The only draw came between Gil Vicente and Vitória de Guimaraes, which finished 0-0.

serie_a.name: Serie A
serie_a.text: Frosinone Calcio's 5-1 win over US Lecce was the biggest margin of the recent Serie A results, while ACF Fiorentina and Atalanta BC played out a 2-2 draw. Other notable results included AS Roma's 5-2 win at Udinese Calcio and AC Milan's 3-1 victory over FC Internazionale Milano.

super_lig.name: Süper Lig
super_lig.text: Recent Süper Lig results saw Konyaspor lose 0-4 to Galatasaray, while Genclerbirligi beat Alanyaspor 5-0 for the biggest margin. Kocaelispor and Caykur Rizespor drew 0-0, and Kasimpasa and Besiktas drew 2-2.

conference_league.name: Conference League
conference_league.text: The biggest margin of the recent Conference League results was Ajax Amsterdam's 6-1 win at FC Midtjylland. There were four draws: AGF 0-0 Braga, Atalanta BC 1-1 Kairat Almaty, KuPS Kuopio 0-0 KAA Gent, Riga FC 1-1 Jablonec, and Sint-Truidense 1-1 SK Brann.
